### Key Business Value
- **Sales Pipeline Management**: Track opportunities from initial contact through closed-won revenue
- **Revenue Forecasting**: Accurate pipeline and revenue predictions for business planning
- **Customer Relationship Management**: Complete 360-degree view of customer interactions and relationships
- **Territory & Team Management**: Sales territory optimization and team performance analytics
- **Partner Channel Management**: Partner-driven sales and channel partner performance tracking

## 🔴 Critical Salesforce Sales Rules

### 1. **Record Types & Data Segmentation**
- **Opportunity Types**: Different opportunity record types (Standard, Renewal, Upsell, Cross-sell)
- **Account Types**: Customer vs Partner vs Prospect account classifications
- **Territorial Alignment**: Geography-based territory management and coverage
- **Product Hierarchies**: Complex product categorization and bundling structures
